																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.

																			Merit Basis: Prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper 2 of the Main Written Examination.

																				General Category: 40%

																				SC / ST and Female Candidates: 32%

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.
																			
																		

																		Final Merit List & Cut-off Criteria

																		
																			
																			Merit Basis: Prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper 2 of the Main Written Examination.
																			
																			
																			Minimum Category-wise Cut-off for Merit Eligibility:

																			
																				
																				General Category: 40%
																				
																				
																				Backward Class (BC): 36.5%
																				
																				
																				Extremely Backward Class (EBC): 34%
																				
																				
																				SC / ST and Female Candidates: 32%
																				
																			
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Bihar Police Company Commander (BHG) 2026: Document Required at the Time of Online Application

																		
																			
																			Qualification Certificates (10th/ SSC/ Matriculation, Graduation & etc.).
																			
																			
																			Address (According to Aadhar/ Voter ID/ Driving License/ Passport/ Ration Card/ Birth Certificate ).
																			
																			
																			Scan Recent Passport Size Photo in JPEG/ PNG Format.
																			
																			
																			Scan Signature in Hindi & English.. Both Signature Will be on White Paper with Black Ink in JPEG/ PNG Format.
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

																		
																			Pay Scale:- Havildar Instructor-  ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400/-  (Level-6)
																			Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Pre Exam, Mains Exam, PET/ PET & Merit List.

																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.

																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.
																			
																		

																		Final Merit List & Cut-off Criteria

																		
																			
																			Merit Basis: Prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper 2 of the Main Written Examination.
																			
																			
																			Minimum Category-wise Cut-off for Merit Eligibility:

																			
																				
																				General Category: 40%
																				
																				
																				Backward Class (BC): 36.5%
																				
																				
																				Extremely Backward Class (EBC): 34%
																				
																				
																				SC / ST and Female Candidates: 32%
																				
																			
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Bihar Police Company Commander (BHG) 2026: Document Required at the Time of Online Application

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.
																			
																		

																		Final Merit List & Cut-off Criteria

																		
																			
																			Merit Basis: Prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper 2 of the Main Written Examination.
																			
																			
																			Minimum Category-wise Cut-off for Merit Eligibility:

																			
																				
																				General Category: 40%
																				
																				
																				Backward Class (BC): 36.5%
																				
																				
																				Extremely Backward Class (EBC): 34%
																				
																				
																				SC / ST and Female Candidates: 32%
																				
																			
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Bihar Police Company Commander (BHG) 2026: Document Required at the Time of Online Application

																		
																			
																			Qualification Certificates (10th/ SSC/ Matriculation, Graduation & etc.).
																			
																			
																			Address (According to Aadhar/ Voter ID/ Driving License/ Passport/ Ration Card/ Birth Certificate ).
																			
																			
																			Scan Recent Passport Size Photo in JPEG/ PNG Format.
																			
																			
																			Scan Signature in Hindi & English.. Both Signature Will be on White Paper with Black Ink in JPEG/ PNG Format.
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

																		
																			Pay Scale:- Havildar Instructor-  ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400/-  (Level-6)
																			Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Pre Exam, Mains Exam, PET/ PET & Merit List.

																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.

																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.
																			
																		

																		Final Merit List & Cut-off Criteria

																		
																			
																			Merit Basis: Prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper 2 of the Main Written Examination.
																			
																			
																			Minimum Category-wise Cut-off for Merit Eligibility:

																			
																				
																				General Category: 40%
																				
																				
																				Backward Class (BC): 36.5%
																				
																				
																				Extremely Backward Class (EBC): 34%
																				
																				
																				SC / ST and Female Candidates: 32%

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.

																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.

																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.

																		Bihar Police Company Commander (Bihar Home Guard) 2026: Exam Pattern/ Syllabus

																		Stage 1: Preliminary Examination (प्रारंभिक परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Exam Nature: Object-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs).
																			
																			
																			Marks & Questions: 200 total marks with 100 questions.
																			
																			
																			Duration: 2 hours.
																			
																			
																			Syllabus: General Knowledge and Current Affairs.
																			
																			
																			Qualifying Criteria: Minimum 30% marks required to clear.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 20 times the number of vacancies will be shortlisted category-wise for the Mains exam based on merit.
																			
																			
																			Normalization: Equi-Percentile Method will be used if the exam is held in multiple shifts.
																			
																		

																		 

																		Stage 2: Main Examination (मुख्य परीक्षा)

																		The Mains exam consists of two mandatory papers:

																		
																			
																			Paper 1 (General Hindi):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Requires a minimum qualifying score of 30%.
																				
																				
																				Marks obtained will not be counted towards the final merit list.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Paper 2 (General Studies):

																			
																				
																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
																				
																				
																				Syllabus: General Studies, General Science, Civics, Indian History, Geography, Mathematics, and Mental Ability Test.
																				
																			
																			
																			
																			Negative Marking: For both stages (Prelims & Mains), 0.2 marks will be deducted for every incorrect answer.
																			
																			
																			Selection Multiplier: Candidates equal to 6 times the total vacancies will be selected category-wise for the Physical Test based on Paper 2 scores.
																			
																		

																		Stage 3: Physical Efficiency Test (शारीरिक दक्षता परीक्षा)

																		
																			
																			Qualifying in nature; candidates must pass according to the specified physical criteria to remain in the selection process.
																			
																		

																		Final Merit List & Cut-off Criteria

																		
																			
																			Merit Basis: Prepared strictly based on the marks scored in Paper 2 of the Main Written Examination.
																			
																			
																			Minimum Category-wise Cut-off for Merit Eligibility:

																			
																				
																				General Category: 40%
																				
																				
																				Backward Class (BC): 36.5%
																				
																				
																				Extremely Backward Class (EBC): 34%
																				
																				
																				SC / ST and Female Candidates: 32%
																				
																			
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Bihar Police Company Commander (BHG) 2026: Document Required at the Time of Online Application

																		
																			
																			Qualification Certificates (10th/ SSC/ Matriculation, Graduation & etc.).
																			
																			
																			Address (According to Aadhar/ Voter ID/ Driving License/ Passport/ Ration Card/ Birth Certificate ).
																			
																			
																			Scan Recent Passport Size Photo in JPEG/ PNG Format.
																			
																			
																			Scan Signature in Hindi & English.. Both Signature Will be on White Paper with Black Ink in JPEG/ PNG Format.
																			
																		
																		
																	
																	
																		
																		Pay Scale & Mode of Selection

																		
																			Pay Scale:- Havildar Instructor-  ₹35,400 to ₹1,12,400/-  (Level-6)
																			Selection Process: Selection on the Basis of Pre Exam, Mains Exam, PET/ PET & Merit List.

																				Total 200 marks, 100 questions, and a 2-hour duration.
